label: SI-14(1)
title: Refresh from Trusted Sources

statement.prose: Obtain software and data employed during system component and service refreshes from the following trusted sources: {{ insert: param, si-14.01_odp }}.

guidance: Trusted sources include software and data from write-once, read-only media or from selected offline secure storage facilities.

params.label: trusted sources
guidelines: trusted sources to obtain software and data for system component and service refreshes are defined;
